name: ThreeDTiles
description: OGC 3D Tiles dataset (photogrammetry meshes, point clouds, buildings) streamed onto the globe. Globe-only.

supportedData.label: OGC 3D Tiles tileset
supportedData.description: A 3D Tiles tileset (entry tileset.json) referencing b3dm/i3dm/pnts/glTF content — e.g. photogrammetry meshes, point clouds, or extruded buildings. Streamed and LOD-managed by the globe engine. Supports opacity, a height offset and a Cesium3DTileStyle.
supportedData.procurement: Produce with a 3D Tiles tiler (e.g. py3dtiles, Cesium ion, or a photogrammetry pipeline); host the tileset directory statically.

components.name: Layer Name
components.description: A display name for the layer.

components.name: Initial Visibility
components.description: Whether the layer is on initially.

components.name: URL
components.description: URL to a 3D Tiles tileset.json endpoint. For OSM buildings, use a provider like MapTiler or a self-hosted 3D Tiles server.

components.name: Max Screen Space Error
components.description: Controls level-of-detail quality. Lower values produce higher quality at the cost of performance. Default: 16.

components.name: Max Memory (MB)
components.description: Maximum GPU memory in MB for this tileset. Default: 512.

components.name: Height Offset (m)
components.description: Vertical offset in meters. Use to adjust building placement relative to terrain.

components.name: Color Expression
components.description: A Cesium 3D Tiles style color expression. Example: color('#ffffff') or color('white', 0.8). Leave empty for tileset defaults.

components.name: Show Expression
components.description: A Cesium 3D Tiles style show expression to filter features. Example: ${Height} > 10. Leave empty to show all.
